name: codex-session-improver
description: Turn local and remote Codex session evidence into redacted, reviewable instruction and skill patches applied only when explicitly selected.

interface.longDescription: Analyze settled Codex sessions on one controller and its SSH hosts, retain only redacted findings, and present exact AGENTS.md, skill, or Markdown patches as individually annotatable proposals.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $codex-improver to run the next safety-gated session review now. Analyze only; do not apply proposals.
